outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and engages the upper door handle, then pulls the door outward: separation from the oven body becomes visible around frames 92–105 and increases through frames 120–163 (image and left_ego_image). At frame 163 the door is visibly ajar, although not fully lowered. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or displacement of unrelated tabletop objects is visible.
